children: Shares of Alpha Teknova plummeted after the life sciences company commenced a proposed public stock offering.
Alpha Teknova shares were down 22.1% in late Tuesday trading to $5.76. The stock finished the day at $7.39, and had nearly doubled year to date.
Teknova intends to grant underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 15% of shares.
The company also issued preliminary third-quarter results with an expected revenue between $12.5 million and $12.7 million. Analysts polled by FactSet expect $11.7 million.

The company expects adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization to between a loss of $1.2 million to $1 million. Those earnings would represent an at least 25% improvement compared to the same time last year.
Teknova expects gross margin for the third quarter between 36% and 38%. The company expects cash and short-term investments at $16.6 million.
